profile.headline: Kindo
profile.summary: Yale '19, Computer Science BSc. Interests: distributed systems, mobile app dev, privacy, law & tech, consumer software, security. tmux, vim, zsh enthusiast.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Re-architected Kindo’s agent harness around durable execution, making long-running agent runs resilient to restarts, transient LLM provider errors, and infrastructure failures.
- Led platform-wide observability for production AI agent execution, migrating from Datadog auto-instrumentation to vendor-agnostic OpenTelemetry and establishing PII- and cardinality-safe standards for logs, traces, metrics, alerts, and dashboards.
- Automated first-line on-call workflows for proactive monitoring, alert response, deploy-specific checks, debugging, and triage using OpenClaw and MCP tooling, reducing incident MTTR 50%+.
- Architected Kindo’s MCP integration platform from the ground up and helped scale delivery to 100+ integrations across enterprise SaaS, ticketing, file storage, observability, SIEM, and ERP systems.
- Served as engineering owner and technical lead for strategic enterprise accounts representing millions in ARR, from discovery and solution design through deployment, launch, support, and reusable platform improvements.
- Drove key implementation work for the self-managed version of Kindo across Kubernetes deployment, installer automation, observability, E2E validation, and operational readiness for regulated enterprise environments.
- Established AI-assisted engineering workflows for agent-driven PRs, autonomous review/eval loops, and repeatable internal development practices.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Led development of core merchant and payments infrastructure at Snackpass, including kiosk ordering, payouts reconciliation, split payments, remote device management, and customer-restaurant messaging.
- Built the initial self-order kiosk platform from scratch and led small teams through early productization and scale; the system has grown to process hundreds of millions of dollars in GMV annually.
- Re-architected payout and accounting workflows with automated reconciliation and catch-up systems, reducing risk of merchant payout gaps and supporting Stripe Connect KYC, onboarding, and alcohol-sales requirements.
- Led cross-functional refactor to support split bills and multiple payment methods per order, requiring coordinated changes across ordering, payment processing, accounting, and merchant-facing surfaces.
- Built merchant operations systems for Android device management and in-app messaging, improving restaurant onboarding, supportability, customer communication, refunds, rewards, campaigns, and AI-assisted workflows.

positions.title: Head Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
I was the head teaching assistant for Yale's two introductory computer science courses: CPSC 100 (Fall) and CPSC 112 (Spring).
I held weekly sections and office hours, trained & managed course staff, set up & ran events, tutored students one-on-one, and graded student work (C, Java, Python, JS, HTML/CSS).
